description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dippitiyawatta, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District (25/0010)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration procedures. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land and property-related administrative matters.
